question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Pahari is the most ________ spoken language in Himachal Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is **commonly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Commonly: **​normally; usually.

 
 
• **Example: **​This is the most commonly used form.
 
 
 
• Commonly</str
